text:
sana: Deploy bot just flagged noisy failures on canary v3.0.0 during the 10% stage. Change window ends in 30m. Need stop/go.

deploy-bot: [auto] Canary 10% -> error rate 1.3% (baseline 0.15%), p95 +210ms. Event ref: f9a2c. No auto-rollback. See /deploy 18221 for details.

tom: can someone share the error breakdown? 5xx vs 4xx?

e: eli: mostly 5xx gateway errors, correlation with embedding fetch TTL misses.

sana: link: https://telemetry.redwood.internal/canary/18221 — you can see KV eviction spikes around the same time.

ops-bot: [alert] embedding-service instance pool shows elevated connection churn in region-us-west-2.

helen: thumbs — agree we should pause progression to 25%. Hold at 10% and pin rollout to v2.9.9 as a safe fallback.

tom: to be clear: pin prevents further traffic increases but keeps current canary traffic at 10%?

sana: yes. Running: `rollout pin --deployment inference-canary --version v2.9.9 --by sana --reason "kv eviction -> downstream 5xx"`

deploy-bot: [action] Rollout pinned to v2.9.9 by sana at 4210001260. Traffic frozen at 10%.

eli: I'll try a mitig: increase cache size + TTL on the new nodes, and flip a pre-warm job. ETA 12m. Also will add extra retries on embedding client (backoff 200->800ms).

product: hold other change windows for this service in this shift. Need user-facing threshold: error <0.2% for rolling 15m before resuming.

helen: if mitigation doesn't fall back under threshold in 25m, we should evaluate a rollback across canary region (full rollback to v2.9.9).

sana: agreed. Also updating release notes: add a note under "Known issues" and the rollback criteria.

eli: mitigation started. Will post results once pre-warm completes.

deploy-bot: [update] mitigation job kicked: prewarm-evict-fix job started at 4210001280.

helen: small ask for docs team: please include a short blurb on how kv-config impacts embedding timeouts in the next release notes patch.

product: adding that to release notes now.

sana: thanks. If metrics look good in 15m we'll unpin and continue a conservative bump to 20% with manual oversight.

eli: pre-warm done, KV miss rate down 60% on new nodes. Re-running the smoke checks.

ops-bot: [metric] error rate now 0.22%, p95 down to +45ms.

helen: that's within the allowed ramp criteria but still above baseline. I'd prefer to watch for 15m before any bump.

tom: agreed. Vote: wait 15m -> continue OR rollback. Please react with :+1: to continue monitoring, :-1: to rollback now.

sana: :+1:

eli: :+1:

helen: :+1:

product: :+1:

ops-bot: [action] Hold continues. Monitoring window extended to 15m.

sana: will update the postmortem draft with timeline and actions once we close the window. Thanks everyone.
